summary: Decompose run_taskand_request in queue runners to reduce cyclomatic complexity

delivery.outcome: Decompose run_taskand_request in src/koru/queue/runners.py into focused helpers (config, health probe, target resolution, reply parsing, gateway POST, CLI fallback) to reduce its cyclomatic complexity from 47 to <=7 while preserving 100% backward-compatible behavior, and pin the previously uncovered branches with regression tests.
nonGoals: Changing gateway/CLI selection strategy or request semantics
Modifying TaskandRunResult shape or the module's public interface
Reformatting pre-existing code outside the decomposed function

architecture.decision: Extract _taskand_gateway_config, _probe_taskand_gateway, _taskand_gateway_target, _parse_taskand_gateway_payload (with _orchestrator_taskand_result and _proc_call_taskand_result behind a _TaskandReplyContext NamedTuple), _post_taskand_gateway (with _read_taskand_reply, _taskand_http_error_result, _taskand_url_error_result) and _run_taskand_cli_call from run_taskand_request in src/koru/queue/runners.py, leaving run_taskand_request as a compact strategy dispatcher with _TaskandGatewayConfig and _TaskandGatewayTarget NamedTuple carriers.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket-262 commit in src/koru/queue/runners.py and tests/test_queue_runners.py

validation.evidence: All existing and newly added taskand runner tests pass.
run_taskand_request cyclomatic complexity drops from 47 to <=7; no extracted taskand helper exceeds 11.
code2llm cc signal for queue.runners.run_taskand_request is at or below the limit of 15.
Ruff reports zero lint errors for the touched files.
Governance check passes with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
